question: Which of the following did Emperor Akbar NOT construct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jama Masjid of Delhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Masjid-i-Jehan-Numa** commonly known as the Jama Masjid Located in Old Delhi, India.
 
• **Commissioned by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan**, It was **inaugurated** **by** the first Imam, **Syed Abdul Ghafoor Shah Bukhari**.
 
• **Architectural Style**: Islamic architecture, **Architect**: Ustad Khalil.
 
• **Two Minarets:** Each 40 meters high, flanking the mosque**. Three Domes**: Situated above the prayer hall are its key elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buland Darwaza (Door of Victory)** is located at Fatehpur Sikri in Agra.
 
• It was built in 1602 AD by **Mughal Emperor Akbar** to commemorate his victory over Gujarat in 1573.
 
• **Agra Fort** was designated as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 1983**.
 
• **Shah Jahan was held a prisoner** in Agra Fort by his son Aurangzeb.
 
• Fatehpur Sikri was the **first planned city of the Mughals.**
 
• Upon moving the **capital to Lahore in 1585**, Fatehpur Sikri remained an area for **temporary visits **by the Mughal emperors.
